scenarios.title: A noncreature permanent with sunburst enters with one charge counter per color of mana spent, and none for colorless mana

setup.notes: Sol Ring is untapped and can produce {C}{C}.

decisions: A casts Pentad Prism (cost {2}), paying with one Plains ({W}) and the Island ({U}).
Both players pass; Pentad Prism resolves.

variants.label: two_colors
variants.expected: Pentad Prism enters the battlefield with 2 charge counters (one for white, one for blue).

variants.label: one_color
variants.delta: A pays {2} with both Plains ({W}{W}) instead.
variants.expected: Pentad Prism enters the battlefield with 1 charge counter (white was the only color spent).

variants.label: colorless_only
variants.delta: A pays {2} by tapping Sol Ring for {C}{C} instead.
variants.expected: Pentad Prism enters the battlefield with 0 charge counters, because no colored mana was spent.

scenarios.title: A creature with sunburst enters with one +1/+1 counter per color of mana spent

setup.notes: Etched Oracle is a 0/0 artifact creature costing {4}. The two Sol Rings are untapped and each can produce {C}{C}.

decisions: A casts Etched Oracle (cost {4}), paying with three Plains and the Island.
Both players pass; Etched Oracle resolves.

variants.label: two_colors
variants.expected: Etched Oracle enters with 2 +1/+1 counters and is a 2/2 on the battlefield.

variants.label: one_color
variants.delta: A pays {4} with all four Plains instead.
variants.expected: Etched Oracle enters with 1 +1/+1 counter and is a 1/1 on the battlefield.

variants.label: colorless_only
variants.delta: A pays {4} by tapping both Sol Rings for {C}{C}{C}{C} instead.
variants.expected: Etched Oracle enters with no +1/+1 counters, because no colored mana was spent, and is put into the graveyard as a 0/0 by the next state-based check.

scenarios.title: Sunburst adds no counters when the permanent enters from somewhere other than the stack

setup.notes: A has two copies of Etched Oracle: one in hand and one in the graveyard.

decisions: A casts the Etched Oracle from hand (cost {4}), paying with the Swamp and the three Plains.
Both players pass; Etched Oracle resolves.

variants.label: cast_from_hand
variants.expected: Etched Oracle enters with 2 +1/+1 counters (black and white) and is a 2/2 on the battlefield. The Etched Oracle in the graveyard and Zombify in hand are untouched.

variants.label: reanimated
variants.delta: A casts Zombify (cost {3}{B}) targeting the Etched Oracle in the graveyard, paying with the Swamp and the three Plains, instead of casting the Etched Oracle from hand.
variants.expected: Zombify resolves and Etched Oracle enters the battlefield from the graveyard with no counters, as a 0/0, and is put into the graveyard by the next state-based check. The Etched Oracle in hand stays in hand.

scenarios.title: Modular with sunburst sets the number of +1/+1 counters from the colors of mana spent

setup.notes: Arcbound Wanderer is a 0/0 artifact creature costing {6} with Modular-Sunburst. The three Sol Rings are untapped and each can produce {C}{C}.

decisions: A casts Arcbound Wanderer (cost {6}), paying with four Plains, the Island and the Swamp.
Both players pass; Arcbound Wanderer resolves.

variants.label: three_colors
variants.expected: Arcbound Wanderer enters with 3 +1/+1 counters (white, blue, black) and is a 3/3 on the battlefield.

variants.label: one_color
variants.delta: A pays {6} with all six Plains instead.
variants.expected: Arcbound Wanderer enters with 1 +1/+1 counter and is a 1/1 on the battlefield.

variants.label: colorless_only
variants.delta: A pays {6} by tapping all three Sol Rings for {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{C} instead.
variants.expected: Arcbound Wanderer enters with no +1/+1 counters, because no colored mana was spent, and is put into the graveyard as a 0/0 by the next state-based check.
